models.construction: Take R1 boundary C8, whose half-cycle orbit cover has four two-element fibers, and any R2 cover with four two-element fibers. Suppose phi is a cover isomorphism.
models.witness: The target deck delta_q is a nontrivial cover automorphism, so delta_q∘phi is a second isomorphism. A canonical/natural phi fixed under target automorphisms would satisfy delta_q∘phi=phi, impossible.

models.construction: Fix a combined S5+S6 model and replace mu by c mu, c>0, c!=1.
models.witness: R1/R2/R3/R5 and N are unchanged; R4 J is divided by c.

models.construction: Fix a combined model and replace N by aN, a>0, a!=1, leaving mu and all S6 data fixed.
models.witness: Every perimeter scales by a, so R4 J scales by a^2 while R2/R3/R5 do not change.

models.construction: Fix an admissible scalarizer lambda and replace it by b lambda, b>0, b!=1.
models.witness: Frozen R5 class and all group-cover data are unchanged; P_lambda scales by b.
